description:
modules/parentbilling — GET /traeger/billing-runs/{id}/cost-takeovers/{costBearerId}/export
(#5627), every statement: the Träger transaction and its binding, the
run, the cost bearer, the issued invoices and their positions in one
statement each, through Enrollment the period, the registrations with a
proof and the entry in the period's trail, the confirmation days and the
entry in the run's trail. No statement per invoice.
